name: Quick returners, win backs at 10:00
hypothesis: Horses back within 1-4 days win more than their price says.

evidence.claim: research win A/E 1.148 at the morning price, 1.055 at the BSP; not significant on 33 days (p 0.21)
GBP50 to win, GBP100 a bet, GBP2,000 a day a model

exit: each back laid at the Betfair SP for a liability equal to its winnings (the owner, 16 Nov 2026: 'quick returners too'); 2022-26 at GBP50 to win, trade out GBP5,014 vs hold GBP8,348, daily sd 9.7 vs 46.6; trade-out deflated Sharpe 0.21 (fails)
